hero.subtitle: Every week we document a topic seen in class here: what it is, how we applied it in the project, and what we learned along the way.
entries.heading: Entries
about.heading: What is this log?
about.body: This site is the public part of our university project. It works as a progress blog: every topic seen in the course is documented as an entry, with the theory, its practical application in the project, and the lessons learned. This keeps the progress ordered and visible to anyone — including the professor 😉.
post.i18n.title: Internationalization (i18n)
post.i18n.summary: How to prepare an application to speak several languages: translation files, language detection, and dynamic text without duplicating code.
post.guards.title: Guards and minimal security
post.guards.summary: We protected the app's private routes: what a guard is, how it decides whether a user can enter, and why every app needs this basic layer.
post.next.title: Next course topic
post.next.summary: This entry will be published when we cover the next topic in class. The log grows with the course.
auth.login.subtitle: Sign in with your username to see your account.
auth.register.title: Create account

auth.forgot.title: Recover password
auth.forgot.subtitle: Type your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgot.sent: If that email has an account, the link is already on its way. It expires in 30 minutes.

auth.reset.subtitle: Choose the password you will sign in with from now on.

auth.error.EXPIRED_TOKEN: The link expired. Request a new one.
auth.error.UNEXPECTED: We could not complete the operation. Try again.

store.filter.heading: Filters

cart.title: Your cart
cart.subtitle: What you have collected so far. Nothing has been sent yet.
cart.full: The cart holds 10 distinct products. Remove one to add another.
cart.note.price: Each product keeps the price it had when you added it: the catalogue belongs to a third party and can change.
